facts.fact: Hattie 走进 Sloan 未上锁的房子，并随手关门挡风。
她打开厨房灯，确认那部泛黄的有线电话仍在原处，拿起听筒听到拨号音后放下。
facts.anchor: The same yellowed, corded telephone sits neatly at the end of the counter atop the most current phone book.

facts.fact: 她从厨房走到图书馆一路数步：十二步、约三十六英尺。
facts.anchor: Twelve paces. Thirty-six feet, give or take.

facts.fact: 她不假思索地把被拉倒的低书架扶正，并把书一本本摞回去。
facts.anchor: Without thinking, she rights the low bookcase that’s been pulled over, spilling its knowledge on the wood floor.

facts.fact: 她在黑暗中喊出最害怕说出口的那个名字“Tommy?”。
头顶地板发出咯吱声，接着脚步声一级一级从后楼梯下来。
一个影子走进月光，她认出那件皱旧工装、破相的鼻子和认得出来的眼睛。
facts.anchor: An untrimmed beard hanging down almost to the breastbone with a spectacularly broken nose folded flatly to one side above it

facts.fact: 她 whisper 出“Tommy”后眼前一黑昏倒。
facts.anchor: “Tommy,” she whispers before the world tips on its side and blackens to nothing.
